messages:
marta: FYI rollout to canary blocked, p99 decode jumped ~2.5x after last merge. observed on a subset of long-chat workloads. :grimacing:

samir: ack, can you paste the CI perf job link and a quick diff?

marta: https://ci.internal/reports/2026/19250 - compare build 284 vs 283. Diff looks like kernel-selector heuristic change + fused-op reorder.

cheng: grabbing perf profiles now. initial flame:
```
# top samples
20% fused_ops::fused_attn_kv_copy
18% decoder::kv_lookup
11% attention::generic_cuda
  ...
```
Feels like fused path is triggering extra memcopies for cached KV entries.

olivia: @cheng can you run `./tools/prof --config canary --trace kv` and post the small snippet?

cheng: ran it. snippet:
```
[trace] step=1 decode: kernel=fused_attn_kv_copy time=1.8ms kv_hits=0.02
[trace] step=2 decode: kernel=attn_native time=0.8ms kv_hits=0.98
```
When fused_attn path is chosen, kv_hits drop dramatically (we're losing prefix reuse).

jon: that would explain higher tail latency + token cost. Any recent change to kernel selection?

samir: yeah commit `c7a4b2e` from yesterday relaxed size heuristic so fused path can be chosen for seq_len < 256. previously we forced attn_native for any cached prefix.

marta: exact commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serve/+/c7a4b2e. message: "prefer fused ops for compact micro-batches". Might be over-aggressive.

olivia: can someone run a quick bisect locally to confirm revert fixes canary? simple test: run toy workload with long prefix and compare p99.

samir: doing `git checkout c7a4b2e^; bazel test //perf:decode_bench --profile` now.

infra-bot: deploy-canary job queued for cluster canary-3 by samir.

samir: result: reverting c7a4b2e drops p99 from 420ms -> 160ms on the canary trace. Reapply gives regression back.

marta: good repro. action items? revert immediately or add conditional in selector to respect kv_cache_hits threshold.

jon: revert + cherry-pick a guarded heuristic check. Fast revert unblock rollout. :+1:

cheng: i'll draft PR with selector guard: only pick fused_attn if recent_kv_hit_rate < 0.1 OR batch_size > X. will include perf tests.

olivia: opening rollback in prod now. tagging infra. :rocket:

marta: thanks team. add a short postmortem in #postmortems after we stabilize. label: regression, rollout-blocker, kv-cache

samir: note for CI: add a decode_bench variant that simulates long-prefix kv-heavy traces so this doesn't slip again.

marta: agreed. i'll create the issue and assign. :eyes:
